content.description: Speed sensor connectors showing analog type and digital type connectors. Analog type shows SPD① SPD② symbols. Digital type shows SP connector.

content.text: 7. INSPECT SPEED SENSOR NO.1 IN COMBINATION METER

items: Connect an ohmmeter between terminals SPD ① and SPD ②.
Revolve the meter shaft and check that the meter needle repeatedly deflects from 0Ω to ∞Ω.
Remove the combination meter with connected wire harness.
Connect an ohmmeter between terminals SP and GND.
Revolve the meter shaft and check that the voltmeter needle repeatedly deflects from 0V to 2V.

content.description: Pattern selection switch showing terminals 2, 4, and 3 with internal connections

content.text: Inspect that there is continuity between 2 and each terminal.
As there are diodes inside, be careful of the tester probe polarity.

content.description: OD switch showing terminals 1 and 3 with internal connections

content.text: Inspect that there is continuity between 1 and 3.

content.description: Lock-up mechanism installation diagram showing coolant ATF connection and DG terminal

items: Warm up the coolant and ATF.
Connect a voltmeter to the DG terminal and body ground.
Drive at around 50 km/h (31 mph) to where 7.5 or 8V appears on the voltmeter. (this is the lock-up range).
Depress the accelerator pedal and read the tachometer. If there is a big jump in engine rpm there is no lock-up.
